title: Tap-to-Evolve: Feedback Loops and Inflation Thresholds
subtitle: This article deconstructs the tap-to-evolve mechanic, analyzing the click feedback loop and numerical inflation thresholds. It details how clicks drive upgrade pacing and maintain numerical readability, equipping developers with core loop design and balance strategies for casual games.

breakdown.title: Minimum Loop
bullets: Purchase one upgrade within a few seconds

breakdown.title: Inflation Threshold
bullets: Numbers must be readable: K/M/B segments
Changes must be perceptible: multipliers must cross perception thresholds
